title: Anthropology
sourceText:
ANTH 203 [DIVR]

Biological Sciences [BSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

Communication [COMM] or Written Communication [WRTG]

ENGLISH 101 [WRTG]

Foreign Language, if necessary, or Elective
Two years of one foreign language from high school or one year at college required.

ANTH 260

HISTORY 105 [ROOT]

Quantitative Reasoning [QUAN]
STAT 212 preferred.

ANTH 230

Arts [ARTS]

Physical Sciences [PSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

Social Sciences [SSCI]

Electives

ANTH Electives
ANTH Electives (18 credits required): Minimum of 3 credits from each of the following areas: Archeology: ANTH 300, 330, 331, 334, 336, 340, 370, 430; Biological: ANTH 268, 380, 381, 463, 464, 465, 466, 469, 473; Cultural: ANTH 300, 301, 302, 303, 304, 305, 307, 309, 316, 320, 327, 402, 404, 405, 417, 418; Linguistics: ANTH 350, 355, 450.

Equity and Justice [EQJS]

Complete Writing Portfolio

ANTH 390 [M]

ANTH Elective
ANTH Electives (18 credits required): Minimum of 3 credits from each of the following areas: Archeology: ANTH 300, 330, 331, 334, 336, 340, 370, 430; Biological: ANTH 268, 380, 381, 463, 464, 465, 466, 469, 473; Cultural: ANTH 300, 301, 302, 303, 304, 305, 307, 309, 316, 320, 327, 402, 404, 405, 417, 418; Linguistics: ANTH 350, 355, 450.

Humanities [HUM]

300-400-level Electives
Concentrating electives beginning in the junior year in one sub-area of anthropology or in a minor discipline in consultation with the adviser is recommended.

Consider study abroad or summer field school

ANTH 490 [CAPS] [M]

A student may be admitted to the anthropology major upon making their intention known to the department. To graduate, a minimum of 34 credits in anthropology courses are required. Grades of C- or higher are required for all anthropology courses. No required course can be taken pass, fail.
